title: Google Earth AI Geospatial Reasoning Agent: Capabilities and a Systematic Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Google Earth AI is a family of geospatial AI models, together with an agent that orchestrates them. We present this agent, Google Earth AI's Geospatial Reasoning agent (GRA), a Gemini-powered research system that combines geospatial data sources, foundation models, and tools to answer questions about our planet. GRA organizes these into modular domain skills and pairs them with upfront geospatial planning to decompose complex queries into multi-stage workflows. Evaluating such systems is hard: real-world problems admit multiple valid workflows, require data discovery across large catalogs, and rely on evolving ground truth. We introduce two benchmarks and release their development splits. translated_title: Google Earth AI 地理空间推理智能体：能力与系统性评估
translated_abstract: Google Earth AI 是一系列地理空间 AI 模型的集合，并配有一个负责编排这些模型的智能体。我们介绍这一智能体——Google Earth AI 的地理空间推理智能体（GRA），这是一个由 Gemini 驱动的研究系统，它结合地理空间数据源、基础模型和各类工具来回答有关我们星球的问题。GRA 将这些资源组织为模块化的领域技能，并通过前置的地理空间规划将复杂查询分解为多阶段工作流。评估此类系统十分困难：现实世界的问题存在多种有效的工作流，需要在大规模数据目录中进行数据发现，且依赖于不断演变的地面真值。我们提出了两个基准数据集并发布了它们的开发集。其中 GeoExpertQueries 基于从业者的实际用例构建复杂的分析问题，并由地理空间专家加以精炼；每个问题都配有来自三位独立专家达成共识的黄金工作流，并通过经人工验证的、与工具无关的自动评估器进行评分。
tldr: 谷歌推出由 Gemini 驱动的 Google Earth AI 地理空间推理智能体（GRA），它能将复杂的地球相关问题分解为多阶段工作流，并提出两个由专家验证的基准数据集（含 GeoExpertQueries）来系统评估此类智能体的能力。
en_tdlr: Google presents the Gemini-powered Geospatial Reasoning Agent (GRA) of Google Earth AI, which decomposes complex planetary questions into multi-stage workflows, and introduces two expert-validated benchmarks, including GeoExpertQueries, for systematically evaluating such geospatial AI agents.
